text: Payment terms must not exceed 60 days from invoice date. Standard is Net 30.
Late payment penalties must be clearly defined and cannot exceed 1.5% per month.
Liability caps should be limited to the total value of the contract. Unlimited liability is prohibited.
Indemnification clauses must be mutual, not one-sided. Each party covers its own negligence.
Either party must be able to terminate for cause with 30 days written notice.
Termination for convenience requires 60 days notice and is subject to remaining payment obligations.
All data processing must comply with GDPR and applicable local data protection laws.
Data breach notification must be reported within 72 hours of discovery.
Ownership of IP created during the engagement must be explicitly defined in the contract.
Confidentiality obligations survive for at least 3 years after termination of the agreement.
